name: Complex Face and Edge Criterion
definition: Criteria to detect cells containing surface pieces smaller than current subdivision level. Complex face: connected components of voxels on homogeneous cell faces (all vertices inside or outside ∂V). Complex edge: cell edge intersects ∂V more than once, inducing non-manifold surfaces.
summary: The Complex Face and Edge Criterion detects topological complexity in homogeneous regions by identifying disconnected surface components on faces and multiple edge intersections, preserving fine details that standard inhomogeneity checks miss.
